stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
For an indexed family $\{U_i\}_{i\in I}$ in a category $\mathcal C$, write $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal C)$ for the category of semi-representable families, and let $F$ be the functor sending such a family to the presheaf $\coprod_{i\in I}h_{U_i}$ (hypercovering.tex L110–155).
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site with fibre products.
Let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal{C}$.
Let $K$ be a hypercovering of $X$.
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a sheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal{C}$.
Then $\check{H}^0(K, \mathcal{F}) = \mathcal{F}(X)$.
A hypercovering of an object $X$ in a site $\mathcal C$ with fibre products means a simplicial object $K$ of $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal C,X)$ whose level-zero family covers $X$ and for each $n\ge0$ whose morphism $K_{n+1}\to (\mathrm{cosk}_n\mathrm{sk}_nK)_{n+1}$ is a covering (hypercovering.tex L345–359).
For a simplicial semi-representable $K$ and an abelian presheaf $\mathcal F$, $\check H^i(K,\mathcal F)$ denotes the cohomology of the cochain complex associated to the cosimplicial abelian group $\mathcal F(K)_n=\prod_{j\in I_n}\mathcal F(U_{n,j})$ (hypercovering.tex L813–837).

Let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal{C}$.
Let $K$ be a hypercovering of $X$.
Let $\mathcal{I}$ be an injective sheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal{C}$.

$$
\check{H}^p(K, \mathcal{I}) =
\left\{
\begin{matrix}
\mathcal{I}(X) & \text{if} & p = 0 \\
0 & \text{if} & p > 0
\end{matrix}
\right.
$$

Let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal{C}$.
Let $K$ be a hypercovering of $X$.
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a sheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal{C}$.
There is a map
$$
s(\mathcal{F}(K))
\longrightarrow
R\Gamma(X, \mathcal{F})
$$
in $D^{+}(\textit{Ab})$ functorial in $\mathcal{F}$, which induces
natural transformations
$$
\check{H}^i(K, -) \longrightarrow H^i(X, -)
$$
as functors $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal{C}) \to \textit{Ab}$. Moreover,
there is a spectral sequence $(E_r, d_r)_{r \geq 0}$ with
$$
E_2^{p, q} = \check{H}^p(K, \underline{H}^q(\mathcal{F}))
$$
converging to $H^{p + q}(X, \mathcal{F})$.
This spectral sequence is functorial in $\mathcal{F}$ and
in the hypercovering $K$.
